scenes.visual_description: A Victorian breakfast room bathed in soft morning light. A round table set with white linens, silver coffee pot, and toast rack stands in the center. Scattered newspapers cover a side table. A fireplace with a marble mantelpiece anchors the room, filled with the comfortable clutter of bachelor life.

A first-class Victorian train compartment with plush red velvet seats and polished mahogany paneling. A large window reveals the English countryside rushing past in a blur of green. Leather straps hang from the ceiling, and a discarded pile of newspapers lies on the seat.

The interior of an open landau carriage moving through the rolling Devonshire countryside. The sun is low in the sky, casting long shadows across the heather-covered moors. The leather seats are worn but comfortable, with the rhythmic motion of the carriage visible in the changing background.

A modest but comfortable Victorian parlour. A central mahogany table holds a tin box and various small objects under the light of a gas lamp. Floral wallpaper and heavy drapes create a somewhat stifling atmosphere. A red-brick fireplace stands silent.

A depression in the wild Dartmoor landscape. Gorse bushes and ferns surround a muddy hollow. The sky is expansive and grey, with the bleak, rugged terrain stretching out in all directions. A sense of isolation pervades the scene.

The open moorland at sunset. The landscape is tinged with gold and deepening ruddy browns. Faded ferns and brambles catch the dying light. In the distance, the slate roofs of stable buildings are visible against the skyline.

The paved yard of a racing stable establishment. Red-brick buildings with slate roofs surround the courtyard. A large wooden gate stands open. The atmosphere is functional and orderly, with the smell of hay and horses lingering in the air.

A bustling Victorian racecourse enclosure. The wooden rails of the paddock are visible, with the grandstand rising in the background. Colorful jockey silks and sleek horses create a vibrant scene under a bright sky. The energy is high and chaotic.

A private corner of a luxurious Pullman train car. Polished wood veneers, etched glass partitions, and plush upholstery. Gas lamps cast a warm, steady glow against the darkness of the night outside the window. Tobacco smoke hangs lightly in the air.

segments.title: II. The Adventure of the Cardboard Box

scenes.visual_description: A Victorian sitting room stifling in August heat. Yellow sunlight glares harshly against half-drawn blinds, casting hot, dusty stripes across the furniture. A sofa is occupied by a lounging figure; a breakfast table stands neglected. The atmosphere is oppressive, still, and heavy with heat.

A neat, prim Victorian parlour in Croydon. A worked antimacassar rests on a chair, and a basket of coloured silks sits on a stool. Through a window, a small garden shed is visible. The room is tidy, modest, and filled with the quiet tension of a police investigation.

A montage of the Croydon area in late afternoon. A street of two-story brick houses under a softening sun, a moving cab interior, and the exterior of a police station. The light shifts from harsh afternoon glare to a mellow evening glow.

The Baker Street sitting room at night, comfortable and shadowed. Gas lamps cast a steady, warm glow on the clutter of books and scientific equipment. Cigar smoke hangs in the air. The mood is analytical and intimate.

A stark, gloomy police holding cell. Stone walls and a single high barred window. A wooden bench is the only furniture. The atmosphere is despairing and claustrophobic, centered on a man sitting with his head in his hands.

A Victorian breakfast room bathed in soft morning light. A round table set with white linens, silver coffee pot, and toast rack stands in the center. Scattered newspapers cover a side table. A fireplace with a marble mantelpiece anchors the room, filled with the comfortable clutter of bachelor life.

A cosy, well-furnished Victorian room lit by four candles—two on a table, two on the mantelpiece. A writing desk sits in the corner. The atmosphere is intimate but tense, with warm candlelight struggling against the dark, rainy night outside. Heavy drapes cover the windows.

A comfortable Victorian medical practice and study in Paddington, bathed in bright June morning light. A rocking chair sits near the fireplace, and a breakfast table is cluttered with medical journals. The room is modest but tidy, with patient files and a doctor's bag visible.

A first-class Victorian train compartment with plush red velvet seats and polished mahogany paneling. A large window reveals the English countryside rushing past in a blur of green. Leather straps hang from the ceiling, and a discarded pile of newspapers lies on the seat.

A bleak, unfurnished office space on a high floor, lit by the dimming evening light through a dusty window. A single deal table and two chairs sit in the center of the bare floor. The atmosphere is hollow, dusty, and shadowed, with a door leading to an inner room.

The Baker Street sitting room at night, comfortable and shadowed. Gas lamps cast a steady, warm glow on the clutter of books and scientific equipment. Cigar smoke hangs in the air. The mood is analytical and intimate.

scenes.location_header: INT. DONNITHORPE MANOR DINING ROOM - NIGHT
scenes.visual_description: A comfortable Victorian dining room with dark oak paneling and heavy velvet drapes. A table is laden with dessert plates, nutshells, and crystal port glasses catching the candlelight. The atmosphere is warm and digestive, turning tense.

A manicured English lawn bathing in warm afternoon sunshine. Wicker garden chairs sit arranged for conversation. The Norfolk Broads glimmer in the distance. The mood is idyllic until disrupted by a shadow.

A cluttered country house study filled with the smell of stale tobacco and anxiety. A Japanese cabinet stands prominent. Papers are scattered on a desk under the glow of a single oil lamp. Shadows press in from the corners.

The cramped, stifling 'tween-decks of a mid-19th-century convict ship. Wooden partitions are thin and flimsy. Lanterns sway with the ship's motion, casting long, rocking shadows. The air is thick and oppressive.

The officers' mess on a sailing ship, chaotic and smoke-filled. A long table is stained with wine and blood. Muskets and pistols lie scattered among broken glass. The lighting is dim and hazy from gunpowder smoke.

An open lifeboat drifting on a vast, rolling ocean. The sun beats down on the wooden gunwales. In the distance, a massive plume of black smoke rises from the horizon against a pale sky. The mood is isolated and awe-struck.

A Victorian sitting room on a winter night, cluttered with chaotic genius. Chemicals, criminal relics, and stacks of manuscript bundles fill every corner. A coal-scuttle holds cigars; a jack-knife sticks into the mantelpiece. Firelight flickers warmly against the disorder, illuminating a large tin box on the rug.

A clutter of scientific equipment and books fills a modest Victorian sitting room near the British Museum. The atmosphere is academic and slightly cramped. Daylight filters through a window, illuminating a central table covered in papers. The mood is quiet and studious.

The manicured grounds of an ancient manor house under a late afternoon sun. A massive, ancient oak tree dominates the foreground, casting long shadows. In the distance, the grey stone L-shaped manor house stands with mullioned windows. The grass is marked with measuring pegs. The light is turning golden and lower.

A stone-flagged corridor in an old manor house, lit by the low rays of the setting sun striking the floor. The walls are thick stone; the atmosphere is ancient and dusty. A heavy wooden door stands at the end. The mood is tense and discovery-laden.

A small, damp stone cellar lit by a single lantern. A heavy flagstone is pushed aside to reveal a black hole. Firewood is stacked against the walls. A rusted iron ring and a checked muffler lie on the floor. Shadows are deep and ominous, dancing in the lantern light.

A gentleman's study at night, lit by an oil lamp. A battered, shapeless metal crown and dull gems lie on a desk. The room has a historic, feudal feel with dark wood and shadows. The mood is reverent and concluding.

A Victorian breakfast room bathed in soft morning light. A round table set with white linens, silver coffee pot, and toast rack stands in the center. Scattered newspapers cover a side table. A fireplace with a marble mantelpiece anchors the room, filled with the comfortable clutter of bachelor life.

A comfortable Victorian gun-room in a bachelor's country house. Racks of sporting rifles and shotguns line the dark wood-panelled walls. A leather sofa and armchairs sit near a fireplace. Warm evening light from oil lamps casts long shadows.

A sunny breakfast room in a country manor. A table set with silver and china stands before tall French windows overlooking a garden. Morning sunlight streams in, illuminating the polished wood floor and sideboard.
The grounds of a fine Queen Anne manor house. A manicured lawn and garden path lead to the red-brick facade of the house. A hedge lines the perimeter. Daylight is bright and clear.

A spacious Victorian manor kitchen with a stone-flagged floor. A large wooden table stands in the center, with Windsor chairs. A heavy iron range sits in the hearth. The atmosphere is functional and slightly chaotic.
A plainly furnished Victorian bedroom. A simple bed, a washstand, and a small table with a water carafe. A window looks out over the grounds. The room is tidy but unexceptional.
A small dressing room adjoining a bedroom. Coats and dressing gowns hang on pegs. A smoking stand and chair are visible. The space is cramped and disordered.
A gentleman's smoking room with deep leather armchairs and dark wainscoting. A side table holds a brandy decanter and glasses. Tobacco smoke hangs lightly in the afternoon sun.

A comfortable Victorian study at night, illuminated by the warm glow of a hearth fire and a gas lamp. A rocking chair sits near the fireplace, with a pipe rack and medical journals nearby. The atmosphere is quiet and domestic, with deep shadows in the corners.

A modest street of plain two-story red brick houses in Aldershot under the midday sun. The architecture is military and uniform. Dust motes dance in the bright sunlight. The atmosphere is quiet but tense.

A small, stiflingly hot room with a coal fire burning despite the summer heat. The air is thick and close. Cheap, worn furniture crowds the space. Shadows dance against peeling wallpaper from the firelight.

The Baker Street sitting room at night, comfortable and shadowed. Gas lamps cast a steady, warm glow on the clutter of books and scientific equipment. Cigar smoke hangs in the air. The mood is analytical and intimate.

A grand Victorian staircase and landing in deep shadow. A single gas jet flickers uncertainly, casting long distorted shadows against the flocked wallpaper. Heavy mahogany banisters curve upward into darkness. The atmosphere is tense and claustrophobic.

A large, comfortably furnished Victorian bedroom. A heavy four-poster bed dominates the space, with a prominent black iron strong-box at its foot. Plush carpets and velvet curtains suggest wealth, but the air feels stagnant. Gas light illuminates a marble wash-stand and fireplace.

A prestigious London medical street at night, slick with damp. Tall, imposing Georgian terraced houses line the pavement, their black iron railings gleaming under streetlamps. The sky is dark and cloudy. The mood is somber and reflective.

A Victorian breakfast room bathed in soft morning light. A round table set with white linens, silver coffee pot, and toast rack stands in the center. Scattered newspapers cover a side table. A fireplace with a marble mantelpiece anchors the room, filled with the comfortable clutter of bachelor life.
